'''Roman''' (Japanese: '''チアキ''' ''Chiaki'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[DP076|A Full Course Tag Battle!]]''. He appeared along with his fiancée [[Kylie]].

==In animation==
Roman is the owner of the [[Seven Stars Restaurant]] on the [[Valor Lakefront]]. {{pkmn|Trainer}}s must battle him and his fiancée in a [[Double Battle]] in order to eat in the restaurant for free.

Roman and Kylie first battled {{Ash}} and {{an|Brock}} and were easily defeated by them. They were about to battle {{an|May}} and {{an|Dawn}} when {{TRT}} broke into the restaurant and stole all of the food. Roman was upset by this and wondered what his father would say.

After May and Dawn dealt with Team Rocket, Roman and Kylie officially started their battle with May and Dawn. Despite putting up a good fight, they were defeated in the end.

==In the games==
A character named Roman appears at the [[Seven Stars Restaurant]] in the English translation of [[Sinnoh]]-based games and may also be battled in a Double Battle alongside a character named Kylie. However, the game Roman's Japanese name is リオ ''Rio'' and his only Pokémon is different from what is shown in the animated series. In the games, Roman's father is the head cook, while Kylie's father is the owner of the restaurant.

===Quotes===
* Before battle
:''"Fufufu, my date's really enjoying my dad's cooking. She has a dreamy expression after every bite!"''
:''"I'm feeling great! Sure, I'll have a battle with you. That's why you approached us, right?"''

* Being defeated
:''"I never thought I'd lose at Papa's restaurant..."''

* After being defeated
:''"My prowess as a Trainer isn't up to snuff... It's not like my father's scrumptious cooking..."''

==Trivia==
* Roman's Japanese name contains ''aki'', meaning autumn. His fiancée's Japanese name contains ''natsu'', meaning summer.
* [https://www.pokemon.com/us/animation/seasons/11/episode-22-a-full-course-tag-battle/ Pokémon.com's summary for the episode] mentions Roman as '''Charleton''', possibly indicating it was an initially planned name for him.
